description: A sortable 'Pinned' column, a 'Pinned first' entry in the Sort by menus, a pin button and a refresh button in the message list, and access to Microsoft Graph accounts for pin sync.

functions.name: register
functions.description: Registers the custom column and the Sort by menu entries.

pinKeyword.description: Tag key that marks a pinned message.

functions.name: sortByPinned
functions.description: Sorts the message list of a mail tab with pinned conversations first. Returns false if the tab has no message list.

functions.name: isSortedByPinned
functions.description: Whether the message list of a mail tab is sorted by the Pinned column.

functions.name: configureMailList
functions.description: Turns the message list additions on or off: the pin button in place of the cards view's star, the refresh button in the list header, the Outlook-style highlight of unread mail in the cards view, and one card per conversation (threads kept closed).

functions.name: setRefreshState
functions.description: Shows the refresh button as busy or not, with a tooltip.

functions.name: getNewMessages
functions.description: Runs Thunderbird's Get Messages for all signed-in accounts and updates the folders shown in mail tabs. Returns false when no main window is open.

functions.name: listGraphAccounts
functions.description: The ids of the Microsoft Graph accounts.

functions.name: getGraphToken
functions.description: The OAuth access token of a Microsoft Graph account, for calls to graph.microsoft.com. Never prompts for a sign-in.

functions.name: conversationMessageIds
functions.description: The ids of the messages of the conversation (thread, in its folder) of a message, itself included.

functions.name: threadCountsRepaired
functions.description: How many threads had a wrong count of unread mail, set right since start.

functions.name: markThreadRead
functions.description: Marks a conversation as read (if Thunderbird marks displayed mail as read): the selected messages of a mail tab with one row selected. Returns what happened.

functions.name: withAttachments
functions.description: The ones of the given messages that have attachments, from the flag in the message database (no message is read).

events.name: onPinButton
events.description: The pin button of a message in the cards view was clicked.

events.name: onRefresh
events.description: The refresh button in the message list header was clicked.
